description: Guided B1 content batch for The Sound Maze. Each target is spoken aloud; the learner selects its spelling. Draft content is not wired into the live game.

questions.explain: Settle has the stressed short /ɛ/ vowel. Saddle has /æ/, subtle has /ʌ/, and title has /aɪ/.
Public has the stressed /ʌ/ vowel. Panic has /æ/, picnic has /ɪ/, and pocket has /ɑ/.
Damage has the stressed /æ/ vowel. Message has /ɛ/, village has /ɪ/, while manage also has /æ/ but begins with a different consonant and has a different ending.
Giant begins with /dʒ/. Client begins with /kl/, quiet with /kw/, and violent with /v/.
Chemist begins with /k/, although ch is written. Chest begins with /tʃ/, guest with /g/, and jest with /dʒ/.
Psychology begins with /s/ because the initial p is silent. Biology begins with /b/, technology with /t/, and phonology with /f/.
Laughed ends with /t/: the -ed ending is pronounced /t/ after the voiceless /f/ sound. Loved ends with /d/, laughter has an extra syllable, and loaded ends with /ɪd/.
Climbed ends with /d/. Climate ends with /t/, clamp with /p/, and climb has no pronounced final /d/.
Breathes ends with /ðz/. Breath ends with /θ/, breeds with /dz/, and breezes with /zɪz/.
Castle is spelled with a silent t: the word is pronounced /ˈkæsəl/. Cattle has a /t/ sound, cancel has /n/, and hassle begins with /h/.
Station uses -tion to spell the /ʃən/ ending. Stating ends with /tɪŋ/, stature with /tʃər/, and stagnant with /ɡnənt/.
Knuckle begins with /n/ because the k is silent. Nickel begins with /n/ too but has a different vowel and ending; knack has a pronounced /k/.
